meta.description: Ensures an attested OSV report contains no vulnerability at or above the CVSS threshold (default 9)
meta.name: No Critical Vulnerabilities

cvssThreshold.description: Minimum CVSS base score (0-10) that counts as a failing vulnerability. Defaults to 9 (critical).

error.message: Attested OSV report contains vulnerabilities at or above the CVSS threshold: {{ .Outputs.flaggedVulns }}
error.guidance: Remediate or suppress the flagged vulnerabilities, or raise the cvssThreshold context value

assessment.message: Attested OSV report has no vulnerability at or above the CVSS threshold
